purpose: Compare simple fitted GPU latency functions before considering a runtime replacement.
data: KAIST five dense BF16 bundles; separate Vidur FP16 Llama-2 7B/70B corpus on A100/A40 for selection. Vidur H100 and CodeLlama34B reserved for subsequent audit.
known_exposure: Prior KAIST holdout results were already examined. Vidur schema and several H100 example rows were inspected to establish units; H100 is not a pristine blind test. No aggregate H100 scores used for selection.
families_in_order: F6 two bounded shape transitions (compute and memory)
constraints: Nonnegative coefficients; arithmetic speed-limit floor; no hardware/model identity features; no runtime tables; no target latency features.
cv: Five folds grouped by full operator/tensor geometry and TP across GPUs within each source; repeated rows share a fold. Threshold selection is internal to training folds. KAIST folds from previous study retained as a separate audit where applicable.
selection: Choose per operator using grouped cross-validation. Prefer the simplest candidate within max(1 percentage point, paired fold standard error) of the minimum validation MAPE. Additional shape-transition scale is selected using nested inner grouped CV, not outer validation. Select within each source separately rather than pool different software/dtypes.
reporting: Training and out-of-fold MAPE, P95, latency-weighted error, per-op results, GPU/model holdouts, extrapolation tails, candidate complexity, actual formulas, source revisions/hashes/licenses, limitations. All candidate outcomes including regressions retained.
promotion: Do not replace the deployed baseline automatically. Promotion requires explicit comparison of generalization and physical behavior; exploratory profile fit is not end-to-end serving or energy validation.

amendments.iteration: After initial F0–F6 development CV, before F7 fitting and reserved audits
amendments.reason: Activation cost/byte increases with working-set size; hardware YAML supplies L2 capacity. Add one nonnegative cache-transition term; do not change the selection rule.
amendments.family: F7: L+aC+bM+dM*r/(r+s); r=nominal_bytes/L2_bytes; L,a,b,d nonnegative; s chosen by inner CV from the same five-value grid. Baseline F0 uses the original enumerated active-set solver to preserve rank-deficient tie behavior exactly.

amendments.iteration: After initial F0–F6, before final rerun
amendments.reason: Vocab-parallel embedding shards vocabulary, not hidden width: the initial nominal traffic incorrectly divided hidden-row movement by TP. Add a minimal three-coefficient corrected-feature candidate, keeping original F0 unchanged.
amendments.family: F8: original additive relative-L2 fit with corrected embedding bytes n*(4*hidden+8); for non-embedding this is F0.
amendments.validation: KAIST GPU/model audits rerun formula selection exclusively within the training partition. Vidur H100 and CodeLlama remain excluded from family selection.

amendments.reason: Group by canonical executed tensor geometry; replicated normalization and sampler queries share folds across TP. Keep separate measurements but prevent duplicated work in training and validation. Re-run every candidate and audit; do not retune families against reserved scores. Also close metadata files explicitly via read_text.
amendments.validation: Independent tests cover TP-stable folds and equal local activation width under different nominal TP/model shapes.
